page.overview:
Who is Briar?

Briar is character appearing in . She is a teacher at Blueberry Academy.

Briar is a woman with short wavy blonde hair with black iris, red-rimmed-and-white pupil eyes. She wears teal earrings resembling the Terastal phenomenon, a purple jacket, held by a black ribbed shirt, red pants and black loafers. The golden-colored designs on her shirt resemble that of the Scarlet/Violet book cover designs.

Briar is an ecstatic woman who spends a lot of her time researching the phenomenon of Terastalization in Pokémon. She, being the descendant of Heath, studies the Great Crater of Paldea and Area Zero in hopes of uncovering more of her distant ancestor. Her love for her research often causes her to lose focus on almost anything else and she often looses caution of how dangerous a situation can be because of it.

She holds the original Violet/Scarlet book written by Heath himself, which gives her access to information no-one other than her has.
